headline: A Saudi business delegation led by Prince Mansour bin Muhammad Al-Saud, chairman of the Saudi chapter of the Saudi-Pakistani Joint Business Council, visited Karachi Port Trust on Monday and showed interest in investing in Karachi port infrastructure, logistics connectivity and green initiatives.

card.desc: Prince Mansour's delegation visited KPT and was briefed on projects.

caption:
Saudi investors show interest in Karachi Port!
According to Arab News, a Saudi business delegation led by Prince Mansour bin Muhammad Al-Saud visited the Karachi Port Trust (KPT) on Monday. KPT said the delegation showed keen interest in the planned 140-acre Maritime Business District, green port projects, terminal expansion and connectivity projects. Karachi Port handled a record 55.48 million tons of cargo in FY 2025-26.
